defectFixed.statement: The shell window hard-coded port 48123 while PINEGLOW_API_PORT is a supported override (LocalApiService.cs:169). Overriding the port made the health check probe the wrong port, so the catch fired and the window silently loaded the static UI - the UI looked usable but had NO API, with no error shown.
defectFixed.fix: read LocalApiService.Port once and use it for both the health check and the WebView URL
defectFixed.red: the static guard test failed before the fix (listing both hard-coded lines)

a PRE-EXISTING flaky test surfaced in the first full run: NewsLinkHandlerTests.NewsOpen_ValidToken_TamperedId_... asserted a tampered linkId must return 400/404 but got 200 {"ok":true}. It passes alone (16/16) and on full-suite retry (801/0). Root cause: the tamper swaps first/last characters, which is a NO-OP when they are equal (link ids are 32-hex Guid, ~1/16 = 6% chance). Fixed by guaranteeing a different id plus Assert.NotEqual(realId, tampered); the class then passed 5/5 runs.
conclusion: that flake was a TEST bug, NOT a product/security defect - stated explicitly because the assertion was security-adjacent
